answer: The umber schedule is applied in ocean and trellis makes public each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4123 identities would post 1772 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
